text:
maya_cs: Quick sync — ACME Ecom wants a formal SLA/SLO report for renewal next week. they called out uptime, p95 latency, and potential credits. can we confirm numbers we can commit to?

raj_eng: +1. I pulled production metrics. Last 30d service-level: uptime 99.972%, p50 latency 42ms, p95 138ms for text-gen endpoints on their dedicated pool.

lena_ae: They currently expect 99.9% from contract but mentioned they'd be happier with 99.95. also asking for an explicit credit table if we miss targets.

maya_cs: Good. We should avoid overpromising. Proposal: keep contract 99.9% but offer a one-time concession — if monthly uptime <99.9% then 10% invoice credit; if <99.0% then 30% credit. For latency: commit to p95 <=150ms for steady-state, with rolling 7-day measurement. Thoughts?

raj_eng: Sounds conservative and safe. Couple of notes: 1) p95 can spike on large seq lengths; we should scope to default seq (<=1024). 2) We can add automatic fallback routing to a lower-capacity region during incidents to maintain availability — but that affects latency.

maya_cs: Good call re sequence cap. I'll add that to the report: "SLO scoped to requests <=1024 tokens; model variants and fallbacks excluded from latency SLOs."

sre_oncall: ops-bot alert: deploy completed to redwood-dedicated-acme at 2025-11-12T09:12:11Z. No errors. Also attaching last 90d uptime line: `0.99972` average.

lena_ae: The customer asked for monthly SLA reports delivered as PDF plus an explanation of any credits applied. We need a template and owner. Maya, can you own the report and coordinate enablement to walk them through?

maya_cs: I can own. Will draft template: summary + uptime chart + latency percentiles (p50, p95, p99) + incidents summary + credit calc. Will request model/traffic context from Raj.

raj_eng: I'll export metrics: timeseries for uptime (minute granularity), percentile latencies, and sample request distribution (seq len). Also include regressions if any model rollouts happened in period.

maya_cs: For the credit calc, let's use simple formula in the doc so it's auditable: `credit = invoice_amount * credit_pct` where credit_pct from table: uptime >=99.9 -> 0%, 99.0<=uptime<99.9 -> 10%, uptime<99.0 -> 30%. We'll include rounding rules.

lena_ae: Capture renewal risk note: if they push for 99.95 contractual SLO, we need pricing uplift for reserved capacity and a technical review. flag to sales ops if they insist.

maya_cs: Action items:
- Maya: draft report template + sample PDF by EOD Thu (1750002000).
- Raj: export metrics and note any rollouts by EOD Wed (1750001800).
- SRE: confirm fallback/regional routing behavior documented.
- Lena: hold renewal negotiation baseline at 99.9 unless customer agrees to price uplift.

raj_eng: I added a short snippet for the template you can paste:
```
SLO summary:
- Uptime (monthly): target 99.9% (scoped to dedicated pool)
- Latency (p95): target <=150ms (requests <=1024 tokens)
Incident credits:
- >=99.9% => 0% credit
- >=99.0% and <99.9% => 10% credit
- <99.0% => 30% credit
Measurement window: rolling 30-day period, provider timestamps in UTC.
```

maya_cs: Perfect, I'll assemble and tag you for review. Also planning a 30-min enablement call with ACME next Fri to walk through the report and answer questions. Anyone wants to join?

lena_ae: I'll join to support renewal discussion.

sre_oncall: I'll be on standby for any infra questions.

maya_cs: Thanks team — saving notes here for audit. will post the draft link when ready. :thumbsup:
